correctness.rationale: In every dimension n>=4, parameterize ordinary cube words by counts (i,j) in h differing and n-h matching coordinates of two landmarks; passing to antipodal classes halves the binomial sum, and removing the two landmarks yields the full polynomial. Distinct count-orbits have size at least h away from middle, attained by h neighbors; adjacent pairs have floor n-1 attained by n-1 neighbors. The even central layer coalesces swapped coordinate counts and forces lower bound n except for n=4,h=2, where direct polynomial gives 2; exactly n neighbors attain equality. Vertex degree n and sphere size binom(n,n/2)/2 give sharp pair counts. Formula verifier covers n=4..80, all h, direct quotient verifier all unordered landmark pairs n=4..8 and representatives n=9..14. Finite tests do not constitute an unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: Minimum nonempty two-landmark distance fibre is an established, motivated graph-antiresolution privacy invariant. The infinite family F_n has a provably sharp parity reversal in optimal sensor geometry and exact counts of all extremizers, refining complete distance profiles. This is not asserted to solve unrestricted metric antidimension or actual privacy guarantees.
